Puppetry is a skill that lets you create an empathetic link between a puppet and someone else. By making this link stronger through repeated refinements of the puppet, you can affect that person from afar. Puppetry is often confused with the [[Shaman]] skill of [[Vodun]], though one would do well to remember that puppets are not [[dolls]], and vice versa.

The skill of '''Puppetry''' is available to members of the [[Jester]] [[class]], along with [[Pranks]] and [[Tarot]].

==Abilities in Puppetry==
{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Fashion
 |description=Fashion puppets from wood.
 |lessons=
 |syntax=FASHION PUPPET OF <target><br>PUPPET UNRAVEL <target>
 |required=Initial fashion: 50 mana, and 2 Wood<br>Standard fashion: 50 mana<br>Unravel: 750 mana
 |target=Adventurers
 |cooldown=Initial fashion: 2.00 seconds of balance<br>Standard fashion: 2.00 seconds of balance<br>Unravel: 10.00 seconds of balance
 |detail=In order to fashion a puppet, you first need to get yourself 2 wood commodities. After you fashion the first time, you will have for yourself a crude humanoid puppet. In order to make it actually useful, you must then wield the puppet, and FASHION PUPPET OF <target>.<p>As you fashion your puppet of an adventurer over and over, you'll notice that it gets closer and closer to being a semi-living puppet. Further, the more fashions you have with your puppet, the more Puppetry powers will be able to be channeled through the puppet.</p><p>Additionally, your puppet will decay at a rate of 50% every 6 minutes after the last fashion. This effect does not occur for puppets of allied adventurers.</p><p>If you find yourself in need of destroying a puppet that is no longer in your possession, you may unravel it from afar. Note that this is a difficult feat, and will result in being thrown off balance for a long period of time.</p>
}}
